using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using OpenRA.Support;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class DownloadPackageLogicTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task DownloadUrl_DownloadSucceeds_ExtractsPackage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var modData = new ModData();
            var download = new ModContent.ModDownload { Title = "Test Download", URL = "https://example.com/test.zip" };
            var onSuccess = new Action(() => { });
            var widget = new Widget();
            var downloadPackageLogic = new DownloadPackageLogic(widget, modData, download, onSuccess);

            var httpClientFactory = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
            var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var httpResponseMessage = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK);
            httpClient.Setup(h => h.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpCompletionOption>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMessage);

            httpClientFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateClient()).Returns(httpClient.Object);

            // Act
            await downloadPackageLogic.DownloadUrl(download.URL);

            // Assert
            httpClient.Verify(h => h.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpCompletionOption>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task DownloadUrl_DownloadFails_OnErrorCalled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var modData = new ModData();
            var download = new ModContent.ModDownload { Title = "Test Download", URL = "https://example.com/test.zip" };
            var onSuccess = new Action(() => { });
            var widget = new Widget();
            var downloadPackageLogic = new DownloadPackageLogic(widget, modData, download, onSuccess);

            var httpClientFactory = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
            var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var httpResponseMessage = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
            httpClient.Setup(h => h.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpCompletionOption>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMessage);

            httpClientFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateClient()).Returns(httpClient.Object);

            // Act
            await downloadPackageLogic.DownloadUrl(download.URL);

            // Assert
            httpClient.Verify(h => h.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<HttpCompletionOption>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
